notes.title: [Update] Autocomplete system is integrated!!!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34369582/b1e7c60ccfbb85a403149d18d16175b34ebcf8c0.png

Hi, everyone!

I know that many of you guys are having difficulty of finding correct clues for each tag.

Finally, Autocomplete button is integrated in the game. Now you can avoid the clue where you are stuck.

I hope all of you can enjoy the whole story of the game with this update.



 Investigation clue 'Autocomplete' function added (You can fill up any clue after paying coins)
 CIS helper, 'Mini Jane' movement ban option
 Screenmate On/Off option

notes.title: New game The Wake is coming soon! A SPECIAL OFFER for all other games of Somi!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37698990/c88000e7062b7e1c591bf857068186272a73bf1f.png


Hi, there. Everyone.

We are super proud to announce that our new game The Wake is COMING SOON!

The Wake is the last of Somi’s “Guilt Trilogy,” consisting of Replica and Legal Dungeon. The Wake discovers past emotions and wounds through the process of reading and deciphering the journal.


Watch The Wake launch trailer:
[previewyoutube=2Y2PTbchzF0;full][/previewyoutube]


The game developer Somi aspires to deliver his thoughts and stories to people through games. 
Replica describes his guilt regarding to widespread signs of fascism in his country. Legal Dungeon shows his sorrow over the dehumanized legal system which is related to his own job.
And finally in The Wake, Somi focuses on his deeper root of guilt. The game is filled with his own memories and past wounds.

 I hope the distress of the single person can be a source of comport to someone else.

notes.title: Chinese Retranslation Is Now Complete! (Update Ver. 1.3)
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34369582/9a4c74ff0cfa013ddefd3f86f64844094ac8f619.png

To my Chinese-speaking fans,

I am Somi, the developer of Legal Dungeon.

I am happy to announce that the Chinese retranslation of the game is now complete. I would like to offer my sincere apology to the Chinese-speaking fans for the delay in improving the Chinese localization in the game.

The patch should be out by the time this announcement is up. I humbly ask you to please give the game another try with the improved Chinese localization.

This long and difficult process wouldn’t have been possible without the help of my friend Craft at Indienova. Craft and Indienova had no direct relation to the game and yet graciously offered to help with improving Legal Dungeon’s Chinese localization. I can’t thank Craft enough for his time and effort.

To celebrate this major update, Legal Dungeon be on sale to show a small token of my appreciation. In addition, all of the game I’ve developed on Steam will be on sale as well.

I can’t thank the Chinese-speaking fans enough for their patience and feedback. Ultimately, the responsibility falls on me for releasing a game without thoroughly reviewing localizations. I will learn from this experience and make better games as a developer. Your continued support is appreciated.

I do want to iterate that while the new improved Chinese localization went through many quality checks, it is not perfect and many interpretation can and will exist from the player’s point of view in a game such as Legal Dungeon which relies heavily on metaphors and technical terminology. If you have suggestions to further improve the new Chinese localization, please send me your feedback to wingedst [at] gmail [dot] com. Your feedbacks will be carefully reviewed for future updates.

I hope the improved Chinese localization will resonate better and leave a stronger impression.

Thank you,

Somi

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1013750/Legal_Dungeon/

notes.title: 1.17 - Small Fixes
notes.content:
Version 1.17 is uploaded!
A few minor bugs are fixed and repetitive drag-n-drop process has lessened.

- Once you've finished each episode, you don't need to find the same clue in the same episode any more if it is not necessary for the plot.

- Fixed freezing bug when script history is chosen at the beginning of the battle.
